headlines: Aptevo Therapeutics Announced 100% Clinical Benefit Rate Achieved in Phase 1b Trial Evaluating Apvo436 in Combination With Venetoclax & Azacitidine for Venetoclax Treatment Naïve Patients With Acute Myeloid Leukemia

Aptevo Therapeutics Shares Up 106% Premarket After Report Sunday that Company Announced 100% Clinical Benefit Rate Achieved in Phase 1b Trial Evaluating Treatment for Naïve Patients With Acute Myeloid Leukemia

Aptevo Therapeutics PR Confirms 100% Clinical Benefit Rate Achieved In Phase 1b Trial Evaluating APVO436 In Combination With Venetoclax And Azacitidine For Venetoclax Treatment Naïve Patients With Acute Myeloid Leukemia
